title: The Kindle Scribe Colorsoft is a lot of fun, but it’s not a must-have
summary: And of course, the larger display makes reading PDFs and other documents easier. All in all, the Kindle Scribe Colorsoft makes the most sense for students, researchers, and journalers who want one device for reading, annotating, and organizing handwritten notes.
